_comment: Fixed evaluation set for auto-extraction precision (Node N2). positives = durable engineering value / measured outcomes that MUST be kept; negatives = short-term reminders/tasks/planning/meta that MUST be rejected. Bodies here are synthetic, not user-private.

positives.text: Switched the test runner to the Codex runtime venv with PYTHONPATH=src because system Python is missing, and pytest now passes.
Decided to use OIDC trusted publishing for PyPI instead of stored tokens to avoid credential leakage.
Reduced cold-start latency by 40% after caching the profile read.
Always run the publish allowlist check before release because untracked files blocked CI.
